purpose: Measure whether the versioned git-doc KB prototype is natural enough to support a paper-grade private/domain-KB benchmark claim.
current_strengths: Immutable train/eval KB snapshots from git commits.
Line-level citation ids with document path, commit, and line number.
Stale-snapshot abstentions and eval-update answer cases.
Deterministic baselines that expose stale over-answering and write-back leakage.

checks.evidence: Prototype records immutable git commit ids for train and eval snapshots.
Every grounded row has document@commit:line citation ids.
100.0% of questions use deterministic template wording.
100.0% of questions quote the target evidence prefix.
80.0% of questions mention train/eval snapshot labels.
0.0% of questions require synthesis beyond copying one line.
Questions are generated by deterministic local templates, not by human users or an independent teacher.
Repository docs do not model confidential documents, ACLs, or user/team permission boundaries.
Current baselines are deterministic diagnostics, not natural query baselines over a private/domain KB.

required_upgrade_artifacts: A natural-question dataset over immutable train/eval KB snapshots, with questions written without quoting target evidence prefixes.
Question provenance: human author, independent teacher model with ledgered calls, or licensed user-query log with privacy review.
Snapshot-specific evidence packs generated by retrieval rather than nearest-line template construction.
Stale/missing-evidence cases that arise from real update timing or retrieval insufficiency, not only withheld eval-line templates.
Baselines over the natural questions: direct compact RAG, snapshot-aware retrieval guard, WriteBack memory with prior-snapshot provenance, and trained student/scaffold.
Private or enterprise-like semantics if making a private-KB claim: access-control metadata, confidential-document handling, and redistribution-safe artifacts.
paper_implication: The git-doc prototype should be described as a deterministic snapshot diagnostic and upgrade path. It should not be treated as a natural private/domain-KB benchmark until the required upgrade artifacts exist.

llm_budget.note: This audit reads local deterministic prototype artifacts only.
